integrity: Analytic proof with exact branch identities and a reproducible algebraic/numerical checker; no independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to 1<mu<2, 0<epsilon<1, mu(1+epsilon)<=3 and 0<=x<=1; no results about chaotic upper-parameter regimes or stochastic forcing. Relevant later ecological analysis has an unresolved full-text priority risk.
title: Exact disconnected basins and a critical extinction law in a discontinuous logistic dispersal map
